primary_question: For a fixed reviewed Lean theorem and shared initial candidate, does compiler-guided repair improve verified proof success over blind retries and one-shot generation?

decoding.generation_seed_policy: No seed is sent by the current client; provider-side sampling is not claimed deterministic. Retries are transport attempts within one logical completion, never additional replicates.

conditions.paired_initial_candidate: Generate exactly one initial candidate and reuse its exact bytes, identifier, and SHA-256 for A, B, and C.
conditions.fixed_theorem_and_environment: Use the same reviewed theorem, requested model, decoding settings, and Lean/Mathlib environment for all three conditions.

B.name: blind_retry
B.feedback: Theorem, current candidate, and fixed blind-feedback text only; no compiler diagnostics, error messages, derived summaries, or diagnostic-bearing prior conversation.

C.name: compiler_guided_repair
C.feedback: Only structured diagnostics from the immediately preceding failed Lean compilation; persist the exact diagnostic payload and verifier record.

repetition.replicate_policy: One matched A/B/C trajectory per eligible problem. No repeated generation is used to inflate the sample size.

retry_and_stopping.initial_provider_failure: Mark paired run incomplete; do not start conditions without a shared initial candidate.
retry_and_stopping.retry_accounting: Logical completions, wrapper attempts, SDK retry budget, and potentially billable HTTP attempts are separate quantities. Reserve for every possible SDK HTTP attempt before each wrapper transmission; retain reservations for ambiguous outcomes.

analysis.primary_outcome: verified proof success within the condition repair budget
analysis.paired_significance_test: two-sided exact McNemar test on complete matched binary outcomes
analysis.multiple_comparison_correction: Holm step-down across the three planned comparisons
analysis.no_discordant_pairs: Report comparison as non-informative; do not claim equivalence.
analysis.incomplete_runs: Report full eligible-set denominator, complete-case paired analysis, and sensitivity analysis counting incomplete runs as failures.
analysis.category_analysis: Descriptive only; show denominators and intervals.

required_before_real_pilot: archived official pricing source with exact model-specific input/output rates, currency, source URL, and retrieval date
explicit human review of archived pricing evidence and input-framing/token-bound assumptions
verified account-specific generation access for the selected model; model-list membership alone is insufficient
independent semantic/theorem and dataset reviews plus eligible development example
explicit approval of exact theorem, model alias/revision, call limits, and spend cap
reservation persistence tested to complete successfully before every wrapper transmission
